HR2647, the Department of Defense Authorization, FY 2010, passed on passage with recipients Israel. No specific anti-interventionist position provided.

On Motion to Instruct Conferees - Failed (111th Congress, House roll call 754, October 6, 2009) - The vote is about an arms aid measure for Israel included in the Department of Defense Authorization, FY 2010 bill, but does not directly restrict, approve or expand military aid; thus, the vote is not directly anti-interventionist.
On Motion to Recommit with Instructions on HR2647 (Department of Defense Authorization, FY 2010) - Failed
HR2647, the Department of Defense Authorization, FY 2010, passed with recipients including Israel, showing support for military aid and funding.
House passed HR5327, which authorizes assistance to Israel for the Iron Dome anti-missile defense system, on May 20, 2010.
On Agreeing to the Resolution: Providing for consideration of the bill H.R. 5136, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2011. Passed.

HR6523, the Ike Skelton National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2011, passed with recipients Israel. The vote does not directly restrict, approve, or end foreign military aid, arms sales, or hostilities; it is a major bill in the context of national defense authorization.

members.bottom_line: Does not count: no anti vote on arms aid that broke from their own party by this point. (Rule-based from Voteview roll calls.)
